entries: As an action, the bearer of this Runic object can expend any amount of its remaining movement speed to instantly teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within that distance.

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: As an action, the bearer can Invoke the Rune and force two creatures it can see within 60 feet to make a Charisma saving throw, which a creature can choose to fail. If both fail, they instantly switch places.

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Divination

feature: Item: a wand, staff, robe, or spellcasting focus

entries: The bearer of this Runic object can use it as a spellcasting focus to cast the {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect magic} and {@spell identify} spells as rituals, without the material components.

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: As an action, the bearer can Invoke the Rune to empower their vision. For 1 hour, the bearer has {@sense truesight}, sees secret doors and traps hidden by magic, and can see into the Ethereal Plane, all out to a range of 120 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Enchantment

feature: Item: a bracelet, diadem, ring, or necklace

entries: Creatures will treat the bearer of this Runic object one stage friendlier than normal. For example, an indifferent creature might treat the bearer as a friend, or a hostile creature might treat the bearer indifferently. This special treatment instantly ends if the bearer attacks the creature.

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: As an action, the bearer can Invoke the Rune to cast either the {@spell calm emotions}, {@spell charm person} or {@spell command} spell, targeting a number of creatures equal to the Rune Scribe's Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 creature).

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Evocation

feature: Item: a simple or martial melee weapon

entries: When you inscribe the Rune you imbue it with acid, cold, fire, poison, or lighting damage. Whenever the bearer hits with an attack with this Runic weapon, it deals additional damage of the imbued type equal to one roll of your Intellect Die.

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: When the bearer hits with an attack with this Runic weapon, it can Invoke the Rune to cause the attack to deal additional damage of the imbued damage type equal to three rolls of the Rune Scribe's Intellect Die.

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Illusion

feature: Item: a cloak, robe, or suit of armor

entries: As an action, the bearer of this Runic object can change its physical appearance to match that of a creature it has seen before, so long as it has the same arrangement of limbs as the bearer. The bearer can determine the specifics of these changes, including race, coloration, hair length, sex, height, and weight, but it cannot change its size. This illusion does not affect clothing, equipment, or game statistics.
The illusion can be detected with a successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check vs. the Rune Scribe's Intellect save DC.

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: As an action, the bearer of this Runic object can Invoke this Rune to turn {@condition invisible} for 10 minutes. This invisibility ends if they attack or force a saving throw.

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Necromancy

feature: Item: a belt, ring, or suit of armor

entries: The bearer of this Runic object can use a bonus action to grant itself temporary hit points equal to the Rune Scribe's Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point).

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: When the bearer of this Runic object is reduced to 0 hit points, but it is not killed outright, it can Invoke this Rune to fall to 1 hit point instead of 0.

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Transmutation

feature: Item: bracelet, diadem, ring, or necklace

entries: The bearer of this Runic object gains its choice of a 30-foot swimming speed, a 30-foot climbing speed, or has its walking speed increased by 10 feet. As a bonus action, the bearer can switch its current benefit for another from the above list.

entries.name: Invoking this Rune
entries: As an action, the bearer can Invoke this Rune to transform itself into a beast with a CR equal to the Rune Scribe's Savant level or lower, but otherwise using the rules of the {@spell polymorph} spell. However, unlike polymorph, this transformation does not require concentration.

optionalfeature.name: Secrets & Whispers
entries: You have a knack for knowing where to eavesdrop and the right person to bribe. You gain proficiency in {@skill Stealth}. When you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check, you gain a bonus to your roll equal to one roll of your Intellect Die.
Whenever you spend a long rest in a settlement, you can spend 1-hour gathering local rumors to learn of a significant, even secret, event which occurred in there in the last week.

activation.condition: Whenever you spend a long rest in a settlement

optionalfeature.name: Subterranean Morsel

feature: Sample: any Beast with a burrowing speed

entries: For 1 hour, the creature gains {@sense darkvision} out to 60 feet. If a creature already has darkvision, its radius grows by 30 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Sylvan Morsel

feature: Sample: any Fey of CR 1 or higher

entries: For 1 hour, the creature can use a bonus action on each turn to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

optionalfeature.name: Terran Morsel

feature: Sample: any Earth Elemental of CR 1 or higher

entries: For 1 hour, the creature gains {@sense tremorsense|mm} out to a 15-foot radius, and it gains resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

optionalfeature.name: Thalassic Morsel

feature: Sample: any Beast with a swimming speed

entries: For 1 hour, the creature gains a swimming speed equal to its walking speed, and it can hold its breath for up to 10 minutes.

optionalfeature.name: Theology
entries: You are a dedicated scholar of various holy texts and sacred rituals. You gain proficiency in {@skill Religion}, and whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check, you gain a bonus to your roll equal to one roll of your Intellect Die.

You also learn to speak, read, and write {@language Celestial}. Finally, you learn the {@spell ceremony|xge} spell, but you can only cast it as a ritual. For you, the ritual only takes 10 minutes, and you can cast it without the material components once per long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Titanic Morsel

feature: Sample: any Giant of CR 1 or higher

entries: For 1 hour, the creature grows in size to become the size of the Sample giant. While it is enlarged, it must {@status concentration|phb|concentrate} on this effect as if it were concentrating on a spell. Moreover, the creature gains a bonus to its ability checks and saving throws that use its Strength equal to your Intelligence modifier.
You can create a unique Recipe in your Cook Book for each different Giant you have harvested a Sample from.

optionalfeature.name: Traditions
entries: You are a student of local cultures, politics, and traditions. You gain proficiency in {@skill History}, and whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill History}) check, you gain a bonus to your roll equal to one roll of your Intellect Die.
Whenever you make a Charisma check to interact with a local ruler or otherwise important figure and you incorporate a local custom or tradition, you have advantage on your roll.

optionalfeature.name: Verdant Morsel

feature: Sample: any Plant of CR 1 or higher

entries: The creature is instantly cured of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, {@condition poisoned}, a reduction to an ability score, or a reduction to its hit point maximum.

optionalfeature.name: Viscous Morsel

feature: Sample: any Ooze of CR 1 or higher

entries: For 1 hour, when the creature takes acid, lightning, poison, or slashing damage, it can reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1 damage).

optionalfeature.name: Aggressive
entries: The Great Beast can take the Dash action as a bonus action, so long as it ends this movement closer to a hostile creature that it can see, hear, smell, or sense.

optionalfeature.name: Amphibious
entries: The Great Beast can breathe both air and water, and it gains a swimming speed equal to its walking speed.

optionalfeature.name: Body
entries: You channel spiritual power through your body, bending Spirits to your will with physical might. When you choose this Sacred Focus your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again each time you gain a level.

optionalfeature.name: Charge
entries: If the Great Beast moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line then hits a creature smaller than it with its Claw, it deals a bonus 1d6 damage and the creature is knocked prone.

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of Death
entries: Spirits of Death are drawn from the Shadowfell, the Hells, or the Abyss. They lend shamans their powerful sinister magic.

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of Life
entries: Spirits of Life come to aid shamans from the upper planes or the Feywild. They bless shamans with mystic healing magic.

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Fissure
entries: Spirits of Fissure are conjured from the realms on the Plane of Earth. They lend Shamans the unyielding power of stone.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Fissure Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Inferno
entries: Spirits of the Inferno are summoned from the great Plane of Fire. They grant Shamans overwhelming destructive power.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Inferno Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Moon
entries: Spirits of the Moon can be summoned from the astral sea or etherial plane. They grant shamans wondrous magic power.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Moon Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Mystic
entries: Spirits of Mystics are souls of powerful Shamans that come to offer aid. They awaken a Shaman's true spiritual potential.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Mystic Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Sea
entries: Spirits of the Sea are called up from the depths of the Plane of Water. They bestow Shamans with frigid ethereal magics.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Sea Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Storm
entries: Spirits of the Storm are drawn from the great tempests of the Plane of Air. They lend Shamans the wild magic of storms.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Storm Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Sun
entries: Spirits of the Sun are drawn from places of powerful radiant magic. They lend shamans restorative and purifying power.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Sun Spells

optionalfeature.name: Elder Spirit of the Void
entries: Spirits of the Void are called from outer realms beyond the known planes. They grant Shamans dark aberrant magick.

entries.caption: Elder Spirit of the Void Spells

optionalfeature.name: Hardened Shell
entries: The Great Beast gains a +2 bonus to its Armor Class, but its movement speed is reduced by 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Heart
entries: You channel spiritual power into your heart and overwhelm Spirits with powerful emotions. You gain proficiency in both Intimidation and Persuasion, and you can use your Wisdom, in place of Charisma, for any ability checks with those skills.

optionalfeature.name: Keen Senses
entries: The Great Beast has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks that rely on its hearing or smell.

optionalfeature.name: Large Frame
entries: The Great Beast becomes a Large creature. If it is ridden as a mount, the Great Beast can act independently of its rider.

optionalfeature.name: Mighty Leap
entries: Once per turn, the Great Beast can use a bonus action to expend 5 feet of its movement to do a long jump of 20 feet or a standing jump of 10 feet, without a running start.

optionalfeature.name: Mind
entries: You channel spiritual power through your mind, manipulating the Spirits with your keen wit. Whenever you make an ability check or a saving throw that uses your Intelligence score, you can choose to use your Wisdom score instead.

optionalfeature.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: The Great Beast has advantage on attack rolls against any target that has one of its conscious allies within 5 feet of it.

optionalfeature.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The Great Beast has advantage on attack rolls against any target that has one of its conscious allies within 5 feet of it.

optionalfeature.name: Powerful Build
entries: The Great Beast counts as one size larger when determining creatures it can grapple, and the weight it can move or lift. Its movement also is not halved while it is grappling creatures.

optionalfeature.name: Savage Grip
entries: The Great Beast gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed, and it can climb sheer surfaces and upside down on ceilings without making an ability check. The Great Beast also has advantage on saving throws to resist being moved against its will, grappled, restrained, or knocked prone.

optionalfeature.name: Soul
entries: You channel spiritual power through your soul, your serenity soothes Spirits and wards you from harm. While not wearing armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class is equal to 10 + your Charisma modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Awakening
entries: You bind an ancient Spirit of Ascended Consciousness. You can sense the presence of any creature within 120 feet of you so long as it has an Intelligence of 4 or higher. You can also communicate telepathically with these creatures.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Bedrock
entries: You bind an ancient Spirit of Earth which infuses your body with its resilience. Whenever you take damage, you reduce it by your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). Any force, necrotic, psychic, thunder, or radiant damage ignores this feature.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Binding
entries: You can quickly bind a spirit to regain some of your power. Once per long rest, you can use an action to regain one of your expended Conduit Magic spell slots.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Blight
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Disease to infect foes. When you cast a Shaman spell or use Totemic Assault, you can choose for it to deal poison damage in place of its normal damage.

If you deal poison damage with Totemic Assault, you can reduce its damage by 1d8 and force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw instead of Charisma. On a failed save, it is blinded until the beginning of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Challenge
entries: This Spirit compels foes to fight. When you hit a creature with this weapon, it has disadvantage on attacks it makes against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Corrosion
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Entropy to dissolve foes. When you cast a Shaman spell or use Totemic Assault, you can cause it to deal acid damage in place of its normal damage.
When you deal acid damage with Totemic Assault, you can reduce the damage by 1d8 to reduce the target's Armor Class is by 2 (to a minimum of 10) until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Destruction
entries: You bind a Spirit of the Elements to lend you its destructive power. Once per turn, when you hit with a melee attack, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to deal bonus cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage equal to 1d8 per Slot Level.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Draining
entries: This Spirit siphons life from others to restore you. Once per turn when you hit a creature with this weapon, you can deal necrotic damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (min. of 1).

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Dread
entries: You bind a sinister Spirit of Fear to unleash upon your foes. When you use Totemic Assault, you can force the creature to make an Intelligence saving throw in place of Charisma. On a failure, you can reduce the damage by 2d8 to cause the target to be Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Drought
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Fire to burn your foes. When you cast a Shaman spell or use Totemic Assault, you can choose for it to deal fire damage in place of its normal damage.
When you deal fire damage with Totemic Assault, you can reduce the damage by 1d8 to cause all targets within 5 feet of the target to take fire damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Frost
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Ice to freeze your foes. When you cast a Shaman spell or use Totemic Assault, you can choose for it to deal cold damage in place of its normal damage.

If you deal cold damage with Totemic Assault, you can reduce its damage by 1d8 and force the creature to make a Strength saving throw instead of Charisma. On a failure, its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Growth
entries: You bind a Spirit of Verdant Growth to temporarily increase your size. Once between each short or long rest, you can cast the enlarge version of the {@spell enlarge/reduce}on yourself wihtout expending a spell slot or requiring concentration.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Harmony
entries: You bind a Spirit of Friendship which calms your foes. When a creature fails its saving throw against Totemic Assault, you can choose to deal no damage and instead inflict the effects of the calm emotions spell until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Judgment
entries: You bind a heavenly spirit which comes to your aid. Once per short or long rest, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon celestial|xge} spell. Its Totem replaces the normal material components of this spell.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Light
entries: You bind a Spirit of Radiance that restores your spirit when you heal others. Whenever you restore hit points to another creature with a Shaman spell or feature you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1).

activation.condition: When you cast a spell of 1st-level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other then yourself

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Lightning
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Storms to assault foes. When you cast a Shaman spell or use Totemic Assault, you can cause it to deal lightning damage in place of its normal damage.
When you deal lighting damage with Totemic Assault, the creature can't take reactions until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Majesty
entries: You bind an ancient Fey Spirit of royalty that you can unleash to humble your enemies. As an action, you force creatures of your choice within 30 feet that can see or hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they instantly fall prone. Creatures immune to the Charmed condition have advantage on this Wisdom saving throw.
You can use this feature once per long rest at no cost, but you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to use it again.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Midnight
entries: You bind a sinister spirit which you can call to you. Once per long rest, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon shadowspawn|tce} spell. Its Totem replaces the normal material components of this spell.
At 15th level, you use this between each short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Might
entries: This Spirit fortifies your body. When you are wielding this weapon you add your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1) to any Strength and Constitution based ability checks or saving throws you make.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Mirth
entries: You bind a Spirit of Revelry that grants you its vigor. Once between each short or long rest, you can use a bonus action to gain temporary hit points equal to your Shaman level.
You can use this feature twice between each rest at 12th level, and three times between each rest at 18th level.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Peace
entries: You bind an ancient Spirit of Life which deters your enemies. At the end of each short or long rest, you gain the benefits of the {@spell sanctuary} spell, which last until the end of your next short or long rest, or until you break the spell as normal.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Purgation
entries: You bind an infernal spirit to unleash on your foes. Once per short or long rest, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon greater demon|xge} spell, using its Totem in place of the spell's normal material components.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Secrets
entries: You bind a Spirit of Knowledge that lets peer into the minds of others. Once between each short or long rest, you can cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell without expending a spell slot, or the normal verbal or somatic components of the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Serenity
entries: You bind a Spirit of Serenity to still your inner self. Whenever you are forced make a saving throw to resist being Charmed or Frightened, or to resist the effects of an enchantment spell, you have advantage on your roll.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Servitude
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Loyalty to serve you in all things. The Totem you bind this Spirit to is always under the effects of the {@spell tiny servant|xge} spell. Should the Totem be reduced to zero hit points, it regenerates at the end of your next rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Autumn Wind
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Death that comes at the changing of the seasons. When you deal damage to a creature with a weapon attack or with Totemic Assault, it cannot regain hit points until the beginning of your next turn.

activation.condition: When you deal damage to a creature

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Bear
entries: You bind a minor Bestial Spirit granting you the ferocity of a bear. As a bonus action, you can sprout (or retract) ethereal claws from your fingers. When you make an unarmed strike with these claws, you use Wisdom, in place of Strength for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, they deal 1d6 damage.
Should you have two free hands, this d6 becomes a d8.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Bloom
entries: You bind a Spirit of Verdant Growth that enriches the lands around you. Once between each short or long rest, you can cast the {@spell plant growth} spell without expending a spell slot.
Starting at 9th level, the 8-hour version of the {@spell plant growth} spell takes effect on the land surrounding you each time you take a long rest, unless you wish to withhold this effect.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Bog
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Deception to guard your mind. Any attempt to read your thoughts, emotions, alignment, or target you with an Insight check or a divination spell instantly fails.
You are aware that you are targeted by such an ability, but not its source, and you can allow them to work on you.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Cave
entries: You bind a Spirit of Earth that lends you its connection to the ground. While you are touching the ground with a bare feet or hand, you gain tremorsense out to a 30-foot radius, allowing you to sense the presence of any creatures or objects that are touching the ground within the area.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Dawn
entries: You bind a spirit of radiance which you can shield creatures from death. At the end of a long rest, you can cast {@spell death ward} on a creature of your choice, without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Eagle
entries: You bind a minor Bestial Spirit which grants you the sight of the eagles. You gain proficiency in Perception, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Earthquake
entries: You bind a Spirit of Earth that grants you destructive power. Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack, you deal a bonus 1d6 damage of your weapon's type.
This damage bonus increases as you gain shaman levels; at 6th level ({@dice 1d8}), 11th level ({@dice 1d10}), and 17th level ({@dice 1d12}).

activation.condition: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Eclipse
entries: You bind a powerful spirit that grants you resistance to the arcane. You gain resistance to all damage from spells.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Elements
entries: You bind an elemental spirit which you can call to your aid. You can cast {@spell summon elemental|tce} at the level of your Conduit Magic slots, without expending a spell slot or components.
Once you cast summon elemental in this way, you must finish a short or long rest before you can do so again.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Forest
entries: You bind a minor Woodland Spirit that allows you to converse with wild creatures in your own tongue. You are always under the effect of {@spell speak with animals} while you are conscious.
When you reach 7th level in this class, you are also always under the effect of {@spell speak with plants} while you are conscious.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Grave
entries: You bind a Spirit of Death which you can summon to your service. Once per long rest, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon undead|tce}  spell. This Totem replaces the normal material components of the spell.
At 15th level, you use this between each short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Guardian
entries: You bind a powerful Guardian Spirit to come to your defense. Once per short or long rest, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon construct|tce} spell. This Totem replaces the normal material components of this spell.
When you cast {@spell summon construct|tce} in this way, you can only summon the Clay or Stone Construct Spirit.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Harvest
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of wild growth and bounty. Each time you finish short or long rest, you instantly cast the goodberry spell without expending a spell slot or material components.
The berries from this spell last until the end of your next short or long rest, at which point they dissolve into ash.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Hound
entries: You bind a minor Bestial Spirit that grants you the senses of hounds. You gain proficiency in Survival and have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks while in natural environments.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Hunt
entries: You bind a Spirit of the Wild Hunt to enhance your ferocity in battle. Once per turn, when you attack a target that is within 5 feet of one of your allies, you have advantage on your roll.

activation.condition: Once per turn, if your target is within 5 feet of one of your allies.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Mountain
entries: You bind a minor spirit of the earth that hardens your skin like that of solid rock. While you are not wearing any armor or wielding a shield, your Armor Class is equal to 13 + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 13 Armor Class).

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Mystic
entries: You bind a spirit of secret knowledge that grants you the ability to peer into the minds of others. As an action, you can cast {@spell detect thoughts} without expending a spell slot, or requiring the normal verbal or somatic components.
Once you cast detect thoughts in this way, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it in this way again.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Ooze
entries: You bind a Spirit of Water that allows your body to flow like water. As a bonus action, you can cause your body to become pliable (or return to normal). In this state, you can expend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from non-magical restraints or grapples, and you can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch without having to squeeze.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Panther
entries: You bind a minor bestial spirit that grants you the steps of a panther. You gain proficiency in {@skill Stealth}, and have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide in natural environments.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Rains
entries: You bind a minor spirit of water that washes poison away like rain. You gain resistance to acid and poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws to resist being {@condition poisoned}.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the River
entries: You bind a spirit of elemental water which allows you to live underwater. You can breathe both air and water, and you gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Rockslide
entries: You bind a Spirit of Elemental Destruction to crush your foes. Whenever you use Totemic Assault, you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw in place of Charisma. On a failed save, the target suffers the normal damage of Totemic Assault and is knocked prone.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Sapling
entries: You bind a powerful spirit of wild growth which blesses your body with wondrous regeneration. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier, so long as you have no more than half of your hit points left.
You do not gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

activation.condition: At the start of each of your turns, so long as you have no more than half of your hit points left.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Skies
entries: You bind a powerful Spirit of Air which propels you through the skies. You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed. Whenever you take falling damage, you reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Shaman level.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Squall
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Air to lends deadly speed to your strikes. When you miss with a weapon attack, you can use a bonus action to make a single attack against that creature.

activation.condition: When you miss with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Stream
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Water that grants you a protective aqueous coating. You have advantage on any ability check or saving throw you make to resist being grappled, restrained, or stunned, and you can hold your breath for up to 1 hour.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Sunlight
entries: You bind a Spirit of Radiance to help you find success when you fail. Once per long rest when you fail a saving throw, you can choose to re-roll, possibly turning failure into success.
At 15th level you can do so twice between each long rest.

activation.condition: When you fail a saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Swamp
entries: You bind a Spirit of Disease to poison foes. When a creature fails its saving throw against Totemic Assault, you can reduce the damage by 1d8 and cause the target to be Poisoned until the beginning of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Vine
entries: You bind a spirit of wild growth which lends you the power to restrain your foes. You can cast {@spell ensnaring strike (alternate)|llspell} at 1st-level, at will, without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Waves
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Water that allows you to shift like the sea. Once between each short or long rest, you can use a reaction to halve one instance of damage you would take.
You can use this reaction twice between each rest at 9th level, and three times between each rest at 18th level.

activation.condition: When you take damage

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Wilds
entries: You bind a Spirit of the Wilderness which you can call to your aid. Once per long rest, you can expend a Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon beast|tce} spell. Its Totem replaces the normal material components of this spell.
At 15th level, you use this between each short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of the Winds
entries: You bind a minor spirit of the air which lends speed to your steps with a gust of mighty wind. Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
This bonus to your speed increases as you gain shaman levels; at 5th level (10 feet), 11th level (15 feet), and finally at 17th level (20 feet).

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Twilight
entries: You bind a minor Spirit of Shadow that grants you enhanced sight in the darkness. You gain Darkvision out to a radius of 120 feet, within which you can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.
At 7th level, you can see in magic dim light and darkness.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Vengeance
entries: You bind a vengeful Fey Spirit which you can call to your aid. Once per long rest, you can expend one Conduit Magic spell slot to cast the {@spell summon fey|tce} spell. This Totem replaces the normal material components of this spell.
At 15th level, you use this between each short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit of Wrath
entries: You bind a Spirit of Anger which you unleash upon your foes. You can add your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of +1) to the damage roll of Totemic Assault when a creature fails its save.

optionalfeature.name: Strong Jaws
entries: When the Great Beast hits a creature smaller than it with its Bite attack, it can grapple the creature in its jaws (escape DC equals your Spell save DC). While grappling a creature, the Great Beast cannot use its Bite on other targets, but it deals a bonus 1d6 damage to the grappled creature with its Bite.

optionalfeature.name: Thermal Vision
entries: The Great Beast is always aware of the exact location of all warm-blooded creatures that are within 60 feet of it.

optionalfeature.name: Thick Hide
entries: The Great Beast is always aware of the exact location of all warm-blooded creatures that are within 60 feet of it.

optionalfeature.name: Aether Wings
entries: When cloaked in your Spirit Mantle, you manifest ethereal wings that resemble the true nature of your Sealed Spirit. They grant you a flying speed of 60 feet and you can hover.

optionalfeature.name: Colossal Archon
entries: The appearance of your Archon Form inspires legends and myths. When you use {@optfeature Dire Stature|LLOC}, you can grow to become Huge in size if there is room for you to do so. You gain all the benefits of Dire Stature for your increased size.

optionalfeature.name: Dazzling Lance
entries: You can project overwhelming spiritual power. When you use {@optfeature Shimmering Lance|LLOC}, its range becomes (100/300), it ignores half-cover, and treats three-quarters cover as half.

In addition, when you hit with a ranged Iridescent Strike, you can expend a Vessel Magic spell slot to create a spiritual eruption. Creatures within 30 feet of your target must make a Dexterity saving throw. They take ({@damage 6d8}) damage of the type of your Iridescent Strike on a failure, and half on a success.
As you gain Vessel levels the damage of the explosion on impact increases: at 13th level ({@damage 7d8}) and 17th level ({@damage 8d8})

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a ranged Iridescent Strikes

optionalfeature.name: Dire Stature
entries: You can tap into the primordial stature of your Spirit. When you transform into Archon Form, you can choose for this new Form to grow by one size category, so long as there is room for you to do so. For example, your Archon Form may grow from Medium to Large.

For each size category the Archon grows above Medium, the reach of its melee attacks increases by 5 feet, these attacks deal a bonus 1d4 damage on hit, and the Armor Class Bonus in its stat block increases by 1.

optionalfeature.name: Ethereal Grasp
entries: When you seize a creature you hold both physical and spiritual. When you Grapple a creature while cloaked in your Spirit Mantle, the creature must use its Charisma, in place of its Strength, for the ability check or saving throw it makes to escape.

optionalfeature.name: Ethereal Tendril
entries: As an action, you can protrude (or retract) a single Ethereal Tendril, which resembles your Spirit Mantle, from any point on your body. It has a reach of 10 feet and its Strength score equals your Charisma score. You can only have one Tendril manifested at a time, and it can be attacked as part of you. When cloaked in your Spirit Mantle, its reach is doubled.
This Tendril cannot manipulate fine tools or use weapons or shields. However, it can manipulate simple objects, and be used to make Iridescent Strikes, Shoves, or Grapples.

optionalfeature.name: Evoke Spirit
entries: You can release a minor form of the Spirit sealed within you. You learn the {@spell conjure familiar|llspell} spell. It is a Vessel spell for you, but it does not count against your total number of Spells Known. You also learn to cast this spell as a Ritual.
When you cast it, your Familiar resembles a Tiny version of your Sealed Spirit; it shares the creature type of your Archon, can attack on its turn, and uses the Spirit Familiar stat block

optionalfeature.name: Iridescent Shield
entries: You can absorb blows with your spiritual energies. While you are cloaked in your Spirit Mantle and you or another creature within your reach takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce it by your Vessel level + your Charisma modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Lord of Spirits
entries: You can channel the elder authority of your Sealed Spirit to compel powerful entities into your service. As an action, you can conjure one creature of your choice of the same creature type as your Archon Form with a CR of 6 or lower.
This creature appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet, and remains for 1 hour or until it is destroyed.
It obeys your commands completely and will not harm you or your allies. In combat is shares your turn, and will do all it can to obey your commands that don't violate its nature.
Once you use this feature you must finish a long rest before you can call another such creature to your aid.

optionalfeature.name: Minor Magicks
entries: You gain greater control over the power of your Spirit. Once per long rest, you can cast one of your Spirit Magic spells at its lowest level, without expending a Vessel Magic slot.
You can gain this Aspect more than once, but it cannot be used to cast the same Sealed Magic spell more than once.

optionalfeature.name: Opalescent Armor
entries: When you cloak yourself in your Spirit Mantle, you can fortify it with additional might. For the duration, you are Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage but your speed is reduced by 10 feet. Silvered weapons ignore this Resistance.

optionalfeature.name: Otherworldly Maw
entries: The hunger of your Spirit also fuels your life force. Once per turn while you are in Archon Form, you can forgo one of your attacks to instead force a creature within your reach to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d6 necrotic damage and your current temporary hit points increase by half the necrotic damage dealt.
Your temporary hit points cannot exceed twice your level.

optionalfeature.name: Perilous Visage
entries: You reveal a fraction of your Spirit's true power, horrifying all who behold you. When you transform into Archon Form, you can force creatures of your choice that can see you within 60 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, creatures are frightened of you for 1 minute.
Creatures can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success. If it can still see your Archon Form, it has disadvantage on its saving throw.

activation.condition: When you transform into Archon Form

optionalfeature.name: Iridescent Aegis
entries: When you use {@optfeature Iridescent Shield|LLOC} on another creature and it still takes damage, you can choose to take half the remaining damage in its place as part of the same reaction.

optionalfeature.name: Piercing Gaze
entries: Your Spirit enhances your sight to near supernatural levels. Whenever you make an ability check that relies on your sense of sight while cloaked in your Spirit Mantle, you can add your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to your roll.
When cloaked in your Spirit Mantle, you can see normally in magical dim light and darkness, and you instantly detect the presence of Illusion magic and other Shapeshifters.

optionalfeature.name: Primeval Thirst
entries: The ancient Spirit within you can absorb spells to restore its power. When your Archon sees a creature within 30 feet cast a spell, it can use its reaction to force the spellcaster to make a saving throw with its Spellcasting ability. On a failed save, its spell fails. If the failed spell was a level equal to or higher than your Slot Level, you regain one expended spell slot.
You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Primordial Bulwark
entries: You draw out the true primordial fortitude of the Spirit bound within you. Your Archon Form gains resistance to all damage except for force, psychic, and radiant damage.
As a bonus action, you can harden your Archon Form, and until the start of your next turn, whenever you take damage you reduce it by your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

optionalfeature.name: Shimmering Lance
entries: You can hurl bolts of pure spiritual power. When you make an Iridescent Strike as part of an Attack action, you can choose for it to be a ranged spell attack with a Range of (30/90).

activation.condition: Whenever you make an Iridescent Strikes

optionalfeature.name: Spirit Sense
entries: The Spirit bound to you allows you to sense similar beings. When you see a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend with a CR equal to your Vessel level or lower, you learn its creature type, its spellcasting ability, and the level of its highest spell.
Also, while your Spirit Mantle is active, you can see magic as if by {@spell detect magic}, but you must concentrate on this effect.

activation.condition: When you see a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend with a CR equal to your Vessel level or lower

optionalfeature.name: Striking Presence
entries: The Spirit within empowers your force of personality. You gain proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion.
While cloaked in your Spirit Mantle, you have advantage on ability checks you make with one skill from the list above, which you choose when you unlock this Unsealed Aspect.

optionalfeature.name: Sundering Strike
entries: Your strikes assault both body and spirit. Whenever you hit a creature with an Iridescent Strike, you can force it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it cannot concentrate on or cast spells until the start of your next turn. You can only force a creature to make this saving throw once per turn.

activation.condition: Whenever you hit a creature with an Iridescent Strike

optionalfeature.name: Twilight Steps
entries: You can draw on your Spirit's power to phase your physical body into the spirit world. You learn the {@spell spectral passage|llspell} spell, but it does not count against your Spells Known.
As a bonus action, you can cast spectral passage without expending a spell slot. However, when you do so, it only lasts until the end of your turn, but does not require concentration.

optionalfeature.name: Uncanny Strength
entries: The entity bound within you increases your might. You gain proficiency in Athletics. While cloaked in your Spirit Mantle you can use Charisma, in place of Strength, for any Athletics checks you make, including Grapples and Shoves.

optionalfeature.name: Vexing Strike
entries: The power of the entity within you compels foes to stand and fight. When you hit a creature with a melee Iridescent Strike, it has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you until the start of your next turn. Creatures with Immunity to the Charmed condition are also immune to this effect.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee Iridescent Strikes

optionalfeature.name: Aerial Maneuver
entries: As a reaction when you fall, you can expend an Exploit Die to reduce the falling damage by five times your level. If you are not reduced to 0 hit points, you land on your feet.

activation.condition: When you fall

optionalfeature.name: Arresting Strike
entries: When you hit a target with a weapon attack, you can expend one Exploit Die and force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll, and the target's speed is halved until the start of your next turn.

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Attack Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. If it takes the Attack action before the start of your next turn, it makes one additional attack.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Bonebreaking Critical
entries: When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to cripple the target. For 1 minute, it deals half damage with all weapon attacks.
A crippled target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Brace Up
entries: You prepare yourself to take a hit. As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to gain temporary hit points equal to your Exploit Die + your Constitution modifier. Temporary hit points from this Exploit only last for 1 minute.

optionalfeature.name: Breathless Critical
entries: When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to knock the wind from it. For 1 minute, it cannot speak and its speed is halved.
A winded creature can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Craft Oil Bomb
entries: As an action, you expend an Exploit Die and use alchemist's supplies to craft one Oil Bomb which uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Oil Bomb retains potency until the end of your next long rest, then it becomes unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create the Oil Bomb until this Oil Bomb is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Using the Bomb
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to throw the Oil Bomb at a point within 60 feet, where it explodes on impact. A 10-foot square centered on the point is covered in Oil, turning it into {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Creatures in the area on impact, or any creature that enters the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition Prone}.
The Oil retains its potency on the ground for 1 minute.

optionalfeature.name: Craft Simple Trap

otherSummary.entry: procifiency in {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB}
otherSummary.entrySummary: prof. Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools

entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and use tools, natural materials, and adventuring supplies to craft a Simple Trap. This Simple Trap uses the following rules:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Trap remains functional until the end of your next long rest, then it reverts to the raw material used to craft it. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create this Trap until the Trap is triggered or destroyed.

entries.name: Setting the Trap
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to set the Trap in an unoccupied, adjacent 5-foot space.

entries.name: Triggering the Trap
entries: The first Medium or smaller creature to enter the Trap's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it is unaware of the Trap, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes piercing damage equal to your Exploit Die and is {@condition Restrained} by the Trap.
A creature can use its action to repeat the Dexterity saving throw against the Simple Trap, escaping on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Craft Smoke Bomb
entries: As an action, you expend an Exploit Die and use alchemist's supplies to craft a Smoke Bomb which uses the rules here:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Smoke Bomb retains its potency until the end of your next long rest, then it becomes unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Die you spent to create this Smoke Bomb until this Smoke Bomb is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Using the Bomb
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to throw this Smoke Bomb at a point within 60 feet. It explodes on impact. A 20-foot-radius sphere of smoke, which spreads around corners, centered on the impact. The smoke heavily obscures the area and lasts for 10 minutes. It can be dispersed by a moderate wind of at least 10 miles per hour.

optionalfeature.name: Crushing Grip
entries: When you {@action Grapple} a target, you can expend one Exploit Die to enhance your grip on it. When you use this Exploit, and again at the end of each of the {@condition Grappled} creature's turns, it takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Exploit Die.

activation.condition: When you Grapple a target

optionalfeature.name: Dazing Blow
entries: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can expend an Exploit Die to force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll, and it subtracts one Exploit Die from the first ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes before your next turn.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike

optionalfeature.name: Defensive Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet, granting it the benefits of the {@action Dodge} action until the start of your next turn.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Destructive Strike
entries: When you hit a non-magical object with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die, add it to the damage, and that attack deals maximum damage in place of rolling.

activation.condition: When you hit a non-magical object with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Disarm
entries: When you hit a target with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die and force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll, and it drops one object of your choice on the ground in its space.

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Eloquent Speech
entries: You can use Intelligence, in place of Charisma, whenever you make a {@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion} check. If you do so, you can expend an Exploit Die to treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

optionalfeature.name: Feat of Strength
entries: When you make a Strength or Constitution ability check you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and add them to your roll. You can do so after you roll, but before you know the outcome of your check, success or failure.

activation.condition: When you make a Strength or Constitution ability check

optionalfeature.name: Feint
entries: As a bonus action, you expend an Exploit Die to feint, forcing a creature that can see you within 15 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you have advantage on all attacks against that creature until the end of your current turn.

optionalfeature.name: First Aid
entries: As an action, you touch a willing, living creature and expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus). For every Exploit Die spent, that creature regains hit points equal to one roll of its Hit Die + its Constitution modifier (minimum of 0).

optionalfeature.name: Heroic Fortitude
entries: When you make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, you can expend an Exploit Die and add it to your roll. You can do so after you roll, but before you know if you fail.

activation.condition: When you make a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Hurl
entries: In place of an attack, you expend an Exploit Die to throw one object you are holding at a target you can see within 60 feet.
The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, or both the thrown object and target take bludgeoning damage equal to two Exploit Dice + your Strength modifier.
At 11th level, the range of this Exploit becomes 120 feet.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Imposing Presence
entries: You can use Strength, in place of Charisma, when you make an {@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Persuasion} check. When you do, you can spend an Exploit Die to treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

optionalfeature.name: Lunge
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, you can spend one Exploit Die and move up to 10 feet immediately before making that attack, even if this would exceed your speed for that turn. On hit, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll.

activation.condition: When you make a melee attack on your turn

optionalfeature.name: Maneuvering Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet, and that creature can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks}.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Mighty Leap
entries: After you run 10 feet in a line, you can use your bonus action to expend an Exploit Die to long jump up to 30 feet in a line, even if this distance would exceed your speed for that turn.

optionalfeature.name: Mighty Thrust
entries: In place of an attack, you expend an Exploit Die to force one target that you touch to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is knocked back in a line number of feet equal to 5 times your Strength modifier (minimum 5 feet). This distance is halved for every size category the target is larger than you.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Modify Device

otherSummary.entry: proficiency in {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB}
otherSummary.entrySummary: prof. Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools

entries: Over the course of 1 minute, you can expend one Exploit Die and use tinker's or thieves' tools to modify a trap or lock you touch, chaning its DC to equal your Exploit save DC.

To do so, the trap or lock must be deactivated or unlocked, and you must have access to its inner mechanisms. You can't use this Exploit to modify a trap or lock that cannot be reset, or one that has been destroyed beyond repair.

optionalfeature.name: Parry
entries: While you are wielding a Finesse or Versatile weapon, and a creature you can see hits you with a melee attack, you use a reaction to expend one Exploit Die and add it to your Armor Class against the triggering attack.

activation.condition: While you are wielding a Finesse or Versatile weapon, and a creature you can see hits you with a melee attack

optionalfeature.name: Precision Strike
entries: As part of a weapon attack you can expend one Exploit Die and add it to your attack roll. You can use this Exploit after you roll, but before you know if your attack is a hit or miss.

activation.condition: As part of a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Reliable Skill
entries: Whenever you make an ability check using a skill or tool that you are proficient in and roll a 7 or lower on the d20, you can expend one Exploit Die to treat the d20 roll as an 8.

optionalfeature.name: Reposition
entries: As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to switch places with a conscious and willing creature within 5 feet of you. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks}.
After switching, you or the creature you switched places with gains temporary hit points equal to your Exploit Die.

optionalfeature.name: Riposte
entries: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you use a reaction to expend an Exploit Die to make a melee weapon attack against it. On hit, add your Exploit Die to the damage.

activation.condition: When a creature misses you with a melee attack

optionalfeature.name: Roguish Charm
entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and force one Humanoid who can hear and understand you within 10 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. If it is Hostile toward you, it does so with advantage. On a failure, it is {@condition Charmed} by you for 1 hour, treating you as a friendly acquaintance, though it will not risk its life for you.
This effect ends if you or your allies do anything harmful to the Charmed creature. If this Exploit's effects end in this way, the creature realizes that it was deceived by you.
Once a creature succeeds on its saving throw against this Exploit, it is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

optionalfeature.name: Ruthless Strike
entries: Whenever you hit a target with a melee weapon attack, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and add them to the damage roll of your attack.

activation.condition: Whenever you hit a target with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Savage Rebuke
entries: When a creature you can see hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to expend one Exploit Die to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. On hit, you deal additional damage equal to one roll of your Exploit Die.

activation.condition: When a creature you can see hits you with a melee attack

optionalfeature.name: Shield Impact
entries: When you are wearing a {@item shield|PHB} and a creature that you can see hits you with an attack, you use your reaction to expend an Exploit Die and reduce the damage of the attack by your Exploit Die + your Strength modifier (minimum of 1).

activation.condition: When you are wearing a shield and a creature that you can see hits you with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Skilled Rider
entries: When a trained mount you are riding makes an attack roll, damage roll, ability check, or saving throw, you expend an Exploit Die and add it to your mount's roll. You can do so after it rolls, but before you know if it succeeds or fails.

activation.condition: When a trained mount you are riding makes an attack roll, damage roll, ability check, or saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Steadfast Order
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, it can add your Leadership modifier (minimum of +1) to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Streetwise
entries: You can use Charisma, in place of Intelligence, whenever you make an {@skill History} or {@skill Investigation} check while in a settlement. When you do so, you can expend an Exploit Die to treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

optionalfeature.name: Support Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. That creature can immediately take the {@action Help}, {@action Hide}, {@action Search}, or {@action Use an Object} action.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Sweeping Strike
entries: If you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you expend an Exploit Die and force it to make its choice of a Strength or Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll and the creature is knocked {@condition Prone}.

activation.condition: If you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Taunting Strike
entries: When you hit a creature within 15 feet with a weapon attack, you can expend one Exploit Die to taunt it. Add your Exploit Die to the damage roll, and until the start of your next turn, it has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature within 15 feet with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Trampling Rush
entries: If you move at least 20 feet toward a target and hit it with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll and it is knocked {@condition Prone}.

activation.condition: If you move at least 20 feet toward a target and hit it with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Warding Strike
entries: If a creature you can see moves within the reach of a melee weapon you are wielding, you use your reaction to expend an Exploit Die to make a single melee weapon attack against it. On hit, you add your Exploit Die to the damage roll.

activation.condition: If a creature you can see moves within the reach of a melee weapon you are wielding

optionalfeature.name: Arresting Critical
entries: When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to critically disable your target. For 1 minute, its speed is reduced to 0.
A crippled target can make a Constitution saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Blinding Debris
entries: As a bonus action, you expend one Exploit Die to force one creature within 10 feet to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition Blinded} until it uses its action to clear the debris from its eyes.

optionalfeature.name: Bloodthirsty Critical
entries: When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to immediately make another weapon attack against the same target. On hit, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll. You can only use this Exploit once per turn.

activation.condition: Once per turn, when you score a critical hit with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Craft Alchemical Oil
entries: As an action, you expend an Exploit Die and use alchemist's supplies to craft a vial of Alchemical Oil, choosing acid, cold, fire, poison, or lightning. This Oil uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Alchemical Oil retains its potency until the end of your next long rest, at which point it is inert and unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create the Oil until this Alchemical Oil is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Applying Oil
entries: A creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to expend this vial and apply it to one weapon it is holding.

entries.name: Alchemical Strike
entries: For the next 10 minutes, that weapon deals the damage type of the Oil in place of its normal type.

optionalfeature.name: Concussive Blow
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike with force. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or until the start of your next turn its speed is 0, it can't speak, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and attack rolls against it have advantage.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Craft Flash Bomb
entries: As an action, you expend an Exploit Die and use alchemist's supplies to craft a Flash Bomb which uses the rules here:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Flash Bomb retains potency until the end of your next long rest, then it becomes unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Die you spent to create this Flash Bomb until this Flash Bomb is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Using the Bomb
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to throw this Smoke Bomb at a point within 60 feet. It explodes on impact, forcing creatures that can see within 20 feet to make a Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Blinded} for 1 minute. Targets with sunlight sensitivity have disadvantage.
A Blinded creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Craft Greater Trap

otherSummary.entry: procifiency in {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB}
otherSummary.entrySummary: prof. Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools

entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and use tools, natural materials, and adventuring supplies to craft a Greater Trap. This Greater Trap uses the following rules:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Trap remains functional until the end of your next long rest, then it reverts to the raw material used to craft it. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create this Trap until the Trap is triggered or destroyed.

entries.name: Setting the Trap
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to set the Trap in an unoccupied, adjacent 5-foot space.

entries.name: Triggering the Trap
entries: The first Large or smaller creature to enter the Trap's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it is unaware of the Trap, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers the following effects:

items: It takes piercing damage equal to two Exploit Die.
It is knocked {@condition Prone} or {@condition Poisoned} (your choice at creation)
It becomes {@condition Restrained} in the space by the Trap.

entries: A creature can use its action to repeat the Dexterity saving throw against the Greater Trap, escaping on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Craft Simple Poison
entries: As an action, you expend an Exploit Die and use a Poisoner's it to craft one vial of Simple Poison. It uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Poison retains its potency until the end of your next long rest, at which point it is inert and unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create the Poison until this Simple Poison is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Applying Poison
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to expend this vial of Minor Poison and apply it to one weapon or piece of ammunition it is holding.

entries.name: Poisoned Strike
entries: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature, the damage type is changed to poison, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Poisoned} for 1 minute.
The Poisoned creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Crescendo of Violence
entries: When another creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you scores a critical hit, you can use your reaction to spend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus), and grant that creature temporary hit points equal to the Exploit Dice you spent + your Leadership modifier.
Temporary hit points from this Exploit last for 1 minute.

activation.condition: When the target scores a critical hit

optionalfeature.name: Crippling Strike
entries: When you hit a target with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to attack one of its senses, forcing it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll, and it is {@condition Blinded}, {@condition Deafened}, or can't speak (your choice) until the beginning of your next turn.

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Defensive Stance
entries: As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to enter a defensive stance which lasts until you move from your spot or you are {@condition Incapacitated}. In this stance, you add one Exploit Die to your Armor Class against any attack that you can see.

optionalfeature.name: Dirty Hit
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike at a vulnerable point to force it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll, the creature falls {@condition Prone}, and it cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Enlivening Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. Until the start of your next turn, that creature's speed increases by 5 times your Leadership modifier (a minimum of 5 feet), the distance it can long and high jump doubles, and it has advantage on all {@skill Acrobatics} and {@skill Athletics} checks.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Exposing Strike
entries: When you hit a target with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to weaken it. The first attack made against it before the start of your next turn has advantage, and on hit, that attack deals bonus damage equal to your Exploit Die.

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Glancing Blow
entries: When you make a melee weapon attack and miss, you can expend an Exploit Die to immediately repeat your attack against another target within the reach of your weapon. On hit, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll of that attack.

activation.condition: When you make a melee weapon attack and miss

optionalfeature.name: Grasp of Night
entries: In place of an attack, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) to touch a creature, attempting to knock it out. If the creature's remaining hit points are equal to or less than three times the Exploit Dice you spent + your Wisdom modifier, it falls asleep, and is {@condition Unconscious} for 10 minutes.
It wakes up if it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake or slap the sleeping target awake.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Heroic Will
entries: When you make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can expend one Exploit Die and add it to your roll. You can do so after you roll, but before you know if you fail.

activation.condition: When you make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Hold the Line
entries: As a bonus action, you can expend an Exploit Die to form your allies into a defensive position. You and allied creatures within 10 feet that are wielding a weapon or {@item shield|PHB} have the benefits of half cover, which also applies to ability checks and saving throws to avoid being moved against your will.
This Exploit's effects end for all creatures if you leave your space, and they have no effect on {@condition Incapacitated} creatures.

optionalfeature.name: Honor Duel
entries: As a bonus action, you expend an Exploit Die and challenge a creature within 15 feet that can hear and understand you. For 1 minute, it has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you. This effect ends if you target another creature with an attack, ability check, or saving throw.
The creature can make Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Immovable Stance
entries: As a bonus action, you can expend an Exploit Die to enter an immovable stance that lasts until you move from your space.

For the duration, when a creature attempts to {@action Grapple} you, move you, or move through you, it first must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, you Grapple it or knock it {@condition Prone}.

optionalfeature.name: Intimidating Command
entries: As a bonus action, you can expend an Exploit Die to shout a one-word command at a creature that can hear you within 30 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is compelled to obey your command to the best of its ability on its next turn unless its actions are directly harmful to it.

optionalfeature.name: Insightful Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. The target adds your Leadership modifier to the first attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Knock Out
entries: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) in an attempt to knock it out. Roll four Exploit Dice for each Exploit Die you spent, adding your Strength modifier to the total. If that total meets or exceeds the creature's remaining hit points, it falls {@condition Unconscious} for 1 hour.
It wakes up early if it takes damage or regains hit points.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike

optionalfeature.name: Martial Focus
entries: As part of a weapon attack you can expend an Exploit Die to gain advantage on your attack roll. You can use this Exploit after you roll, but before you know if you hit or miss.

optionalfeature.name: Menacing Shout
entries: As a bonus action, you can expend an Exploit Die to force a creature within 30 feet that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is {@condition Frightened} of you until the end of your next turn, or until you are {@condition Incapacitated}.

optionalfeature.name: Mighty Blow
entries: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to empower your strike with great force. You deal bonus damage equal to your Exploit Die and your target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked back in a line a number of feet equal to 5 times your Strength modifier. Targets larger than you have advantage on this saving throw.

activation.condition: When you hit with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Mighty Hurl
entries: In place of an attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to touch a target at least one size smaller than you, forcing it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, you throw it to a space you can see within 30 feet. It can choose to fail. If you use two free hands, you can target a creature equal to your size.

If thrown into an unoccupied space, an unwilling creature lands {@condition Prone}. If thrown into another creature, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or both take bludgeoning damage equal to your Exploit Die + your Strength modifier.
A feature that increases the size of targets you can {@action Grapple} increases the size of targets you can throw with this Exploit.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Pinning Shot
entries: When you hit a creature with a ranged or thrown weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die and force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, add the Exploit Die to the damage and its speed becomes 0.
As an action, the creature can make a Strength check, and on a success the effects of this Exploit end.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a ranged or thrown weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Primal Senses
entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die to temporarily heighten your senses. For 10 minutes you gain a bonus to all {@skill Insight}, {@skill Perception}, and {@skill Survival} checks equal to your Exploit Die, so long as the checks rely on your sense of sight or smell.
You can also smell the presence and location of all poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet, and identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease.
This heightened sense of smell cannot penetrate full cover.

optionalfeature.name: Redirect
entries: When a creature you can see misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to expend an Exploit Die and force it to attack another creature of your choice within range of its attack, adding your Exploit Die to its attack roll.

activation.condition: When a creature you can see misses you with a melee attack

optionalfeature.name: Rending Strike
entries: When you hit a target with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one Exploit Die to target its defenses and force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, add your Exploit Die to your damage roll, and its Armor Class is reduced by 1 until the damage is repaired. This effect is cumulative.

activation.condition: When you hit a target with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Rejuvenating Order
entries: As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. That creature can instantly repeat one saving throw to end one condition currently affecting it.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Resilient Order
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to a creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, it can add your Leadership modifier (minimum of +1) to Wisdom, Charisma, and Intelligence saving throws.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Ringing Critical
entries: When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to daze your target. For 1 minute, that creature must roll a {@dice d4} and subtract the result from every attack roll and saving throw it makes.
The creature can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Ringing Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die and force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it must subtract {@dice 1d4} from all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws the next minute.
The creature can repeat this Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Shattering Slam
entries: In place of an attack, you can strike the ground and expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus), turning the area within 5 feet of you into {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

Creatures in that area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, creatures take bludgeoning damage equal to the Exploit Dice spent + your Strength modifier and fall {@condition Prone}. On a success, they take half damage and do not fall Prone.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Soothing Speech
entries: As an action, you expend one Exploit Die and speak to all creatures that can hear and understand you within 20 feet, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, creatures become Indifferent toward any creature that they can see for the next 10 minutes.
This effect ends if a creature takes damage, is forced to make a saving throw, or it witnesses an ally being harmed.

optionalfeature.name: Surprise Attack
