entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die to command another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet to immediately make a single weapon attack with advantage. On hit, it deals bonus damage equal to your Exploit Die.

optionalfeature.name: Survey Dungeon
entries: You can expend an Exploit Die to spend 10 minutes carefully examining a room, gaining knowledge of one of the following:

items: One natural or mechanical trap within the area.
One active spell in the area that was cast at a level equal to your Intelligence modifier or lower.
One secret compartment, door, or passageway.

optionalfeature.name: Trick Shot
entries: Any time you make a ranged or thrown attack with a Finesse weapon, you can expend an Exploit Die to make a Trick Shot.
This special attack can't have disadvantage, and it ignores cover, so long as it can ricochet off a single surface and hit a target. On hit, add your Exploit Die to the damage roll.

activation.condition: Any time you make a ranged or thrown attack with a Finesse weapon

optionalfeature.name: Volley
entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die to fire a volley of ammunition at a point you can see within normal range of your weapon, forcing creatures of your choice within 5 feet of that point to make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take damage as if they were hit by an attack with your weapon on a failure, and half as much damage on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Whirlwind Strike
entries: In place of an attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to force targets of your choice within your reach to make a Dexterity saving throw. Targets take damage as if they were hit by one attack with your weapon on a failure, and half on a success.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Wild Charge
entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and choose another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. It can immediately move up to its speed toward a hostile creature and make one melee weapon attack against it.
On hit, it deals additional damage equal to your Exploit Die, and if the target is equal to its size or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

optionalfeature.name: Zephyr Slash
entries: As an action, you can expend an Exploit Die, flourish a melee weapon, then instantly move up to 30 feet in a line, forcing all creatures you pass through to make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take damage as if they were hit by one attack with on a failure, and half as much damage on a success.
This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks}.

optionalfeature.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As a bonus action, you can expend an Exploit Die to increase your speed, if only temporarily. For the next minute, you can take the {@action Dash} action as a bonus action on each of your turns, including the bonus action you used to use this Exploit.

optionalfeature.name: Bewildering Blow
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to deal additional damage equal to two Exploit Dice and forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, it cannot take reactions and it must use each of its turns to move in a random direction (determined by {@dice d8}) then make a melee attack against a random creature within its reach (determined by {@dice d4}, or larger if more targets).
These effects last for 1 minute. The creature repeats this Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending these effects on a success.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Confounding Critical
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike its head. For 1 minute, it must subtract a {@dice d6} from every attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes to maintain {@status concentration}.
The creature makes an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Craft Expert Poison
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As an action on your turn, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and use a Poisoner's Kit to craft a single vial of Expert Poison. It uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Poison retains its potency until the end of your next long rest, at which point it is inert and unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Dice spent to create the Poison until this Expert Poison is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Applying Poison
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to expend a vial of Expert Poison and apply it to one weapon or piece of ammunition it is holding.

entries.name: Poisoned Strike
entries: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature, it deals bonus poison damage equal to the Exploit Dice spent in its creation, and the creature must make a Constitution saving throw or it suffers the following effects for 1 minute:

items: It has disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks.
Its speed is halved, and it cannot take reactions.

entries: The creature can repeat this Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the effect ends, but on a failure, it takes poison damage equal to your Exploit Die.

activation.condition: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature

optionalfeature.name: Craft Expert Trap

otherSummary.entry: proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB}
otherSummary.entrySummary: prof. Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools

entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and use tools, natural materials, and adventuring supplies to craft a single Expert Trap. This Expert Trap uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Trap remains functional until the end of your next long rest, then it reverts to the raw material used to craft it. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create this Trap until the Trap is triggered or destroyed.

entries.name: Setting the Trap
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to set a Trap in an unoccupied, adjacent 10-foot space.

entries.name: Triggering the Trap
entries: The first Large or smaller creature to enter the Trap's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it is unaware of the Trap, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers the following effects:

items: It takes bludgeoning or piercing damage equal to three Exploit Dice (choose the damage at creation).
It is {@condition Stunned} and {@condition Restrained} in the space by the Trap.

entries: At the end of each of its turns, a creature caught in the Trap makes an Intelligence or Wisdom (its choice) check against your Exploit save DC, escaping from the Trap on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Daring Rescue
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

When a Friendly creature that you can see within 30 feet is reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to expend an Exploit Die, gaining temporary hit points equal to your level and moving up to twice your speed.

If you move within 5 feet of the downed creature and have a free hand, you can pick them up and carry them up to your remaining speed. If you provoke {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks}, attacks target you, not the creature you are carrying.
At the end of this movement, you stand the creature up, it gains 1 hit point, and your temporary hit points transfer to it.

activation.condition: When a Friendly creature that you can see within 30 feet is reduced to 0 hit points

optionalfeature.name: Destructive Slam
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
In place of an attack, you can strike the ground and expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus). You destroy an adjacent 20-foot cube, turning it into {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.

Creatures in that area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, creatures take bludgeoning damage equal to two Exploit Dice per each Exploit Die you spent, + your Strength modifier and fall {@condition Prone}. On a success, they take half as much damage and do not fall Prone. Structures and objects in this area take the maximum possible damage as if they failed.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Disorienting Blow
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

When you hit with a creature with a melee weapon attack, you expend an Exploit Die to strike with great force, dealing bonus damage equal to two Exploit Dice, and forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failure, it suffers the following effects for 1 minute:

items: Its speed is halved and it cannot take reactions.
Its Armor Class is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 10.
It has disadvantage on all Dexterity saving throws.
On its turn it can only take an action or a bonus action.
It cannot make more than one attack during its turn, even if a feature would allow it to make multiple.

entries: The creature can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this Exploit's effects on a success.
This Exploit's effects do not stack with the {@spell slow} spell.

activation.condition: When you hit with a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Forgotten Knowledge
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
You can expend an Exploit Die to spend 10 minutes focused on a person, object, or location you can see, after which, you remember a piece of lore about the subject of your focus.

This lore might consist of modern tales, forgotten stories, or even secret lore that was never widely known. The more information you have about your focus, the more precise and detailed the information you seem to remember about it.

optionalfeature.name: Gale Slash
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

In place of an attack, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your proficiency bonus) to rend the air in front of you with a melee weapon, forcing targets in an adjacent 20-foot cone to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, targets take slashing damage equal to two rolls of your Exploit Die for each Exploit Die spent + either your Strength or Dexterity modifier. On a successful save, targets take half as much damage.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Heroic Focus
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to enter a heightened state of focus, which requires your {@status concentration} and grants you the benefits below for 1 minute:

items: Your walking, climbing, and swimming speed is doubled.
You gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class.
You have advantage on all Dexterity saving throws.

You gain a special action on each of your turns that can only be used to {@action Dash}, {@action Disengage}, {@action Hide}, {@action Search}, {@action Use an Object}, or to make a single weapon attack.

optionalfeature.name: Incite Violence
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As an action, you can expend an Exploit Die and whisper violent words to a creature that can understand you within 5 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw.

On a failure, it takes psychic damage equal to twice your Exploit Die and uses its reaction to make one melee attack against a target of your choice within its reach. If no target is within its reach, this creature has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Inspirational Speech
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

You can expend an Exploit Die to spend 1 minute giving an inspirational speech to a number of creatures that can hear you equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier. At the end of this speech, targets gain temporary hit points equal to your level.
While the temporary hit points from this Exploit last, the creatures have advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Mighty Shot
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

In place of an attack, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and make a single attack with a ranged or thrown weapon, forcing creatures in straight line out to the weapon's normal range to make a Dexterity saving throw.

On a failure, creatures take damage as if they were hit by that attack + two Exploit Dice per Exploit Die spent, then, if they are Large or smaller, they fall {@condition Prone}. On a success, they take half as much damage and do not fall Prone.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Mythic Athleticism
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to enter a heightened physical sate, which requires your {@status concentration} and grants you the benefits below for 10 minutes:

items: Whenever you make a Strength or Constitution check, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.
Your walking, climbing, and swimming speed is doubled.
You count as one size larger for the purposes of carrying capacity and the size of creatures that you can {@action Grapple}.
Both your long and high jump distances double, even if that distance would exceed your remaining movement.

optionalfeature.name: Mythic Resilience
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
When you take damage from a source you can see, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) to reduce the damage by three Exploit Dice per Exploit Die spent.
If the total rolled exceeds the amount of damage, you gain temporary hit points equal to the remaining amount.

activation.condition: When you take damage from a source you can see

optionalfeature.name: Pack Tactics
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to signal creatures of your choice within 30 feet that see or hear you to fight as a pack. Until the end of your next turn, you and these creatures have advantage on attack rolls, so long as another member of this pack is within 5 feet of your target.
On subsequent turns, you can use a bonus action to extend this effect until the end of your next turn without spending an Exploit Die, for a maximum duration of 1 minute.

optionalfeature.name: Perilous Gambit
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As a bonus action, you can expend an Exploit die to taunt a creature that can see you within 30 feet, imposing the effects below for 1 minute. It fails if the target cannot be {@condition Charmed}.

items: It has advantage on any attack roll it makes against you, but it has disadvantage on all other attack rolls.
If it moves, it can only move closer to you.
Any creature under the effect of one of your Exploits has advantage on its attack rolls against this creature.

entries: The creature can make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If you are within 30 feet of it, it has disadvantage on this saving throw.

optionalfeature.name: Primal Terror
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you spend an Exploit Die and attempt to drive a creature within 5 feet into a fit of primal fear. It must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or it regards all creatures as Hostile for 1 minute. Each time it takes damage, it repeats the saving throw, ending this effect on a success.
The creature chooses the targets of its attacks, spells, and abilities at random, and it must take all {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks}.

optionalfeature.name: Recruit Mercenary
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

You can expend one Exploit Die and spend 1 hour to recruit one Humanoid Mercenary in a settlement of significant size. There must be a willing Humanoid, such as a bounty hunter, an adventurer, or sellsword, as determined by the DM.

You choose to recruit a {@creature Brute|LL:Exploits|Mercenary (Brute)} or {@creature Scout|LL:Exploits|Mercenary (Scout)}, which determines certain traits in its stat block below. They use this stat block and roll their own initiative in combat. On their turn, they do their best to follow any orders you have given. If not, they will defend themselves to the best of their ability.
The Mercenary remains in your service until you dismiss them, they abandon you, or they die. You cannot regain this Exploit Die until the Mercenary leaves your service.
You can only have one Mercenary in your service at a time. Recruiting another causes others to abandon you.

optionalfeature.name: Recruit Informant
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

You can expend an Exploit Die and spend 1 hour to recruit a Humanoid Informant in settlement of significant size. There must be a willing Humanoid, such as an urchin, criminal, spy, thief, or another rapscallion, as determined by the DM.

Your Informant won't aid you in combat or risk their life, but will gather information, rumors, news, and secrets from their settlement. During each long rest, they will seek you out and deliver this information if you are in that settlement.
Your Informant remains in your service until you dismiss them or they die. However, you do not regain the Exploit Die spent on this Exploit until they leave your service.
Having more than one Informant in a settlement increases the accuracy and secrecy of information they can gather.

optionalfeature.name: Roar of Triumph
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

When you score a critical hit, you can expend an Exploit Die to let out a cry that can be heard up to 300 feet away. You and a number of creatures of your choice who can hear you equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Constitution modifier.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit

optionalfeature.name: Savage Defiance
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action you can expend an Exploit Die to issue a primal challenge. Creatures of your choice within 60 feet that can hear you have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you for 1 minute, or until they hit you with an attack.

optionalfeature.name: Survey Settlement
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
You can expend an Exploit Die and spend 1 hour gathering information on 1 square mile of a settlement. You then gain knowledge about three of the following related to that area:

items: Any active factions and faction outposts within the area.
Prominent buildings, gathering places, and cultural sites.
Powerful political, religious, or military leaders.
Loyalties, beliefs, rumors, and fears of the local populace.
Secret alleyways, doors, hideouts, or storefronts.

optionalfeature.name: Survey Wilderness
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
You can expend an Exploit Die and spend 1 hour gathering information on 1 square mile of wilderness. You then gain knowledge about three of the following related to that area:

items: Any settlements or camps with five or more occupants.
Prominent natural formations, bodies of water, and ruins.
Local plants, animals, weather, and ecosystems.
Powerful (CR 1 or higher) creatures that reside within, or have passed through the area within the last 24 hours.
Secret trails, entrances, groves, or monster lairs.

optionalfeature.name: Stand the Fallen
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) to let forth an inspiring shout. Choose allied creatures that can hear you within 30 feet to regain hit points equal to the Exploit Dice you spent + your Leadership modifier.
You can target {@condition Unconscious} creatures at 0 hit points.

optionalfeature.name: Tactical Reposition
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and dictate a strategic course of action to a number of creatures equal to your Leadership modifier (minimum of 1) within 30 feet that can see or hear you. Creatures can use their reaction to move up to their speed without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks}.

optionalfeature.name: War Cry
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you can expend an Exploit Die to issue forth a mighty cry, forcing creatures of your choice that can hear you in an adjacent 30-foot cone to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, creatures drop whatever they are holding and are {@condition Frightened} of you for 1 minute.
If a Frightened creature can't see or hear you, it can use its action repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

optionalfeature.name: Agonizing Strike
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike as to inflict crippling pain and force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw.

On a failure, its speed is halved; it has disadvantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws; and to cast a spell it must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw or its spell slot (or use of that feature) is wasted.
This effect lasts for 1 minute, but the creature can make a Constitution saving throw without disadvantage at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect success.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Befuddling Critical
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one Exploit Die to shatter its focus. If it was {@status concentration||concentrating}, its concentration is broken, and for 1 minute, it has disadvantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws, and it cannot concentrate.
The creature makes an Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit on a creature with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Clandestine Source
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
While in a settlement of sufficient size, you can expend an Exploit Die and spend 1 hour seeking out a significant figure of the criminal underworld to ask questions of.

If such a figure exists, you approach them alone, and make a DC 15 Intelligence or Charisma saving throw (your choice) to convince them to grant you an audience. On a failure, your body is left {@condition Unconscious} somewhere in that settlement.

On a success, you can ask the figure up to five questions. They answer each question with one word ({@i yes}, {@i no}, {@i maybe}, or {@i unclear}). If a one-word answer is misleading, the figure might instead offer a short phrase as an answer to your question.
Once you use this Exploit in a settlement (successfully or unsuccessfully), you cannot use it there again for 7 full days.

optionalfeature.name: Colossal Strength
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As a bonus action, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) to enhance your strength to mythic levels, though this Exploit's effect requires your concentration.
For 10 minutes, the amount of weight you can push, drag, pull, or lift is multiplied by the amount in the table below:
For each size category you are above Medium, the amount of weight you can move as part of this Exploit is doubled.

For example, a Medium-sized Barbarian with 20 Strength could expend 3 Exploit Dice to use this Exploit, multiplying their 20 Strength by 150, to lift up to 3,000 pounds. If they were Large, they'd double this weight to 6,000 pounds.

optionalfeature.name: Craft Advanced Poison
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As an action on your turn, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and use a Poisoner's Kit to craft a single vial of Advanced Poison. It uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Poison retains its potency until the end of your next long rest, at which point it is inert and unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Dice spent to create the Poison until this Advanced Poison is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Applying Poison
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to expend a vial of Advanced Poison and apply it to one weapon or piece of ammunition it is holding.

entries.name: Poisoned Strike
entries: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature, it deals additional acid damage equal to the Exploit Dice spent in its creation, and the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls for 1 hour. If it fails by 5 or more, it is also {@condition Blinded} for the duration.
As an action, the creature can repeat its saving throw. On a success, the effect ends, but on a failure, it takes acid damage equal to your Exploit Die.

activation.condition: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature

optionalfeature.name: Craft Advanced Trap

otherSummary.entry: proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB}
otherSummary.entrySummary: prof. Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools

entries: As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and use tools, natural materials, and adventuring supplies to craft a single Advanced Trap. This Advanced Trap uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Trap remains functional until the end of your next long rest, then it reverts to the raw material used to craft it. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create this Trap until the Trap is triggered or destroyed.

entries.name: Setting the Trap
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to set a Trap in an unoccupied, adjacent 10-foot cube.

entries.name: Triggering the Trap
entries: The first Huge or smaller creature to enter the Trap's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it is unaware of the Trap, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers the following effects:

items: It takes bludgeoning or piercing damage equal to four Exploit Dice (choose the damage at creation).
It is {@condition Stunned} and {@condition Restrained} in the space by the Trap.

entries: Once it is caught in the Trap, a creature cannot free itself. Another creature must use its action to free it from the Trap.

optionalfeature.name: Dance of Death
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action on your turn, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and choose a number of targets you can see within 30 feet equal to 1 + the number of Dice expended, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take damage of one hit with your weapon + your Exploit Die on a failure, and half as much on a success.
For each creature you reduce to 0 hit points, you can force another creature in range to make the Dexterity saving throw.
Once the Exploit ends, you appear in an unoccupied space of your choice next to the last target of this Exploit.

optionalfeature.name: Equip Militia
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

You can expend one Exploit Die and spend 1 hour training a number of Humanoids equal to your level. Any creature that spends an hour training with you gains two benefits from the list below, which last until the creature finishes a long rest. You cannot regain this Exploit Die while these benefits last:

items: They gain proficiency with one {@filter martial weapon|items|type=!futuristic;martial weapon;!modern;!renaissance;!treasure|miscellaneous=mundane}.
They gain proficiency with {@filter light armor|items|type=!futuristic;light armor;!modern;!renaissance;!treasure|miscellaneous=mundane} and {@item shield|phb|shields}.
They gain temporary hit points equal to your level.
They gain proficiency in one of the following skills: {@skill Animal Handling}, {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Medicine}, {@skill Survival}, or {@skill Stealth}.
They gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Expert Focus
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you expend an Exploit Die to temporarily focus on one of your skills. Choose a skill or tool you are proficient in. For 1 hour, whenver you make an ability check with that skill you gain a bonus to your roll equal to your Exploit Die.

optionalfeature.name: Fluid Movements
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to enter a heightened state of focus, which requires your {@status concentration}. For 1 minute, you have Immunity to the {@condition Grappled}, {@condition Paralyzed}, and {@condition Restrained} conditions, your speed can't be reduced, and {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks} against you have disadvantage.

optionalfeature.name: Heroic Order
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature that can see or hear you within 30 feet. Until the start of your next turn, that creature gains Resistance to all damage, and it has advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Quick Draw
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}
As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to enter a heightened state of focus which requires your {@status concentration}.
For 1 minute, you can use your bonus action, (including the bonus action used to activate the Exploit) to make two ranged weapon attacks so long as you have enough ammunition.
This Exploit's effects don't stack with the {@spell swift quiver} spell.

optionalfeature.name: Revitalizing Order
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As part of your {@action Attack} action, you can forgo an attack to issue this Order to another creature within 30 feet that died within the last minute. It regains hit points equal to your level + your Leadership modifier and can stand up.
This Exploit cannot return a creature to life that has died of old age, nor does it restore missing body parts.

activation.condition: In place of an attack during your Attack action

optionalfeature.name: Staggering Blow
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike with near-supernatural power, dealing bonus damage equal to three Exploit Dice. The target must succeed a Wisdom saving throw, or for the next minute it has disadvantage on all attack rolls and ability checks and it cannot take reactions.
The creature can make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending this effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Subjugate Beast

otherSummary.entry: proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling} or {@skill Intimidation}

entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you can expend an Exploit Die and attempt to dominate one {@loader Beast|creature/LaserLlama; Compendium of Beasts.json} that can see or hear you within 30 feet, forcing it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is {@condition Charmed} by you. This effect lasts for 1 minute, but any time the Beast takes damage, it repeats this saving throw, ending this effect on a success.

While Charmed, you can use your bonus action to issue a command to the Beast, specifiying a simple course of action, which it follows to the best of its ability. If it doesn't recieve a command, it instead defends itself to the best of its ability.

optionalfeature.name: Sundering Strike
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

In place of an attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike a creation of magical force, such as a {@spell prismatic wall}, {@spell resilient sphere}, or {@spell forcecage} with a melee weapon. Magical creations from a spell slot of 3rd-level or lower are instantly destroyed.
If it was created by a spell slot of 4th-level or higher, make a Strength check. DC equals 10 + the level of the spell slot. On a success, the magical creation is instantly destroyed.

activation.condition: In place of an attack

optionalfeature.name: Unbreakable
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

If you take damage that would reduce you to 0 hit points, even if that damage would kill you outright, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and fall to 1 hit point instead. Then, you gain temporary hit points equal to two Exploit Dice per each Exploit Die you spent.

activation.condition: If you take damage that would reduce you to 0 hit points, even if that damage would kill you outright

optionalfeature.name: Victory Surge
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per short or long rest.}

As an action, you can expend an Exploit Die to drive another creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you to fight as never before. The creature can use its reaction to move up to its full speed and take a single action or bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Banishing Strike
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike with legendary power, dealing bonus force damage equal to four Exploit Dice, and forcing it to make a Charisma saving throw.

On a failure, it shunted to a harmless demiplane where it is {@condition Incapacitated}. At the beginning of your next turn, the creature reappears in the unoccupied space closest to the space it left.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Cataclysmic Slam
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

As an action, you can strike the ground with legendary force and expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus). A shockwave ripples outward from you, destroying the ground in a 30-foot radius, turning it into {@quickref difficult terrain||3||difficult terrian}.

Creatures in that area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, creatures take bludgeoning damage equal to two Exploit Dice per each Exploit Die you spent, + your Strength modifier and fall {@condition Prone}. On a success, they take half as much damage and do not fall Prone. Structures and objects in this area take the maximum possible damage as if they failed.

optionalfeature.name: Contingency Plan
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

At the end of a long rest, you can expend one of your Exploit Dice to put an undisclosed contingency plan into place. Until you activate this Exploit again you cannot regain this Exploit Die. You can only have one contingency plan at a time.

As an action, you can reveal your previously undisclosed plan (which you make up at the time of its reveal) and make a DC 20 Intelligence check. You may add a skill the DM deems appropriate to your plan. On a success, your secret plans and preparations take effect perfectly as you described them.
The cost to execute the plan cannot exceed 5,000 gold, and the effects should not exceed those of a 7th-level spell.
For example, you might reveal that you secretly purchased a perfect spell scroll last time you were in a town, or that you paid a mercenary band or airship to come to your rescue.

optionalfeature.name: Craft Masterwork Poison
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
As an action on your turn, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and use a Poisoner's Kit to craft a single vial of Masterwork Poison. It uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Poison retains its potency until the end of your next long rest, at which point it is inert and unusable. You cannot regain the Exploit Dice spent to create the Poison until this Masterwork Poison is spent or destroyed.

entries.name: Applying Poison
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to expend a vial of Masterwork Poison and apply it to one weapon or piece of ammunition it is holding.

entries.name: Poisoned Strike
entries: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature, it deals bonus necrotic damage equal to two Exploit Dice per each Exploit Die spent in its creation, and the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it has disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until a spell of 5th-level or higher is cast on it to neutralize the poison (such as {@spell restoration|llspell}).
If the creature fails by 5 or more, it is {@condition Incapacitated} and it cannot move or speak until it is cured of this Poison.

activation.condition: The next time the Poisoned object deals damage to a creature

optionalfeature.name: Craft Masterwork Trap

otherSummary.entry: proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|PHB} or {@item Tinker's Tools|PHB}
otherSummary.entrySummary: prof. Thieves' Tools or Tinker's Tools

entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
As an action, you can expend one Exploit Die and use tools, natural materials, and adventuring supplies to craft a single Masterwork Trap. This Trap uses the rules below:

entries.name: Consumable
entries: The Trap remains functional until the end of your next long rest, then it reverts to the raw material used to craft it. You cannot regain the Exploit Die spent to create this Trap until the Trap is triggered or destroyed.

entries.name: Setting the Trap
entries: Any creature can take the {@action Use an Object} action to set a Trap in an unoccupied, adjacent 30-foot line.

entries.name: Triggering the Trap
entries: The first Huge or smaller creature to enter the Trap's space must make a Dexterity saving throw. If it is unaware of the Trap, it has disadvantage on this saving throw. On a failure, the creature suffers the following effects:

items: It takes bludgeoning or piercing damage equal to five Exploit Dice (choose the damage at creation).
It is {@condition Stunned} and {@condition Restrained} in the space by the Trap.
Each time it starts its turn in this Trap, it takes damage again as if it had failed the initial saving throw.

entries: Once it is caught in the Trap, a creature cannot free itself. Another creature must use its action to make an Intelligence or Wisdom check (its choice) against your Exploit save DC, freeing the trapped creature on a successful check.

optionalfeature.name: Final Strike
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

As an action you expend an Exploit Die to order a number of Friendly creatures (up to your Leadership modifier) who can hear you within 30 feet to strike a single foe. These creatures immediately take the {@action Attack} action (including Extra Attacks), or cast a spell of 5th-level or lower with a casting time of one action. All attacks and spells must target the designated foe.

optionalfeature.name: Inconceivable Dodge
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

When you take damage, you can use your reaction to expend one Exploit Die and move with supernatural agility and speed to an unoccupied space within 10 feet, {@i somehow} avoiding the triggering effect as if it never affected you at all.

activation.condition: When you take damage

optionalfeature.name: Mortal Blow
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend an Exploit Die to strike with supernatural accuracy at its most vulnerable point. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or it is considered Vulnerable to the damage of this attack. If you had advantage on your attack roll, it makes this Constitution save with disadvantage.
Regardless if the creature succeeds or fails on this saving throw, it takes bonus damage equal to four Exploit Dice.

If this attack reduces the creature to 50 hit points or fewer, it falls {@condition Prone} and is {@condition Stunned} until the start of its next turn. A creature can use a Legendary Resistance to avoid this effect.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Mythic Focus
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
As a bonus action, you can expend one Exploit Die to enter a heightened state of focus, which requires {@status concentration} and grants you the following benefits:

items: You gain 50 temporary hit points. If any of these remain when the effects of this Exploit end, they are lost.
You have advantage on all weapon attacks.
Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, you deal bonus damage equal to your Exploit Die.
You gain a bonus to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws equal to your Exploit Die.
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one additional weapon attack as part of that action.

entries: This effect lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated}. It does not stack with {@spell tenser's transformation|xge}.

activation.condition: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Subjugate Thrall
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
As an action, you can expend an Exploit Die and attempt to dominate one Humanoid that can hear and understand you within 30 feet, forcing it to make a Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save, that Humanoid is {@condition Charmed} by you for 8 hours. It repeats this saving throw any time it takes damage, ending the effects of this Exploit on a success.

While Charmed, you can use your bonus action to issue them a command, specifying a simple or general course of action such as "attack that creature" or "fetch that object", which they do their best to obey. If they do not receive any orders, they defend themselves to the best of their ability.

optionalfeature.name: Storm of Arrows
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
As an action on your turn, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) to fire a volley of ammunition at a point you can see within the normal range of your weapon.

Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of that point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take piercing damage equal to two Exploit Dice per each Exploit Die spent, + your Dexterity modifier. On a success, they take half damage.
You must have enough ammunition to hit each target.

optionalfeature.name: Steel Wind Slash
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

As an action on your turn, you can expend Exploit Dice (up to your Proficiency Bonus) and flourish a melee weapon then vanish. Choose up to five different targets you can see within 30 feet and make a melee weapon attack against each one.

On hit, each target takes damage equal to one attack from your weapon + bonus damage equal to two Exploit Dice per each Exploit Die you spent. After all attacks, you appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of your final target.

optionalfeature.name: Trickster's Blessing
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}

When you take the {@action Hide} action, you can expend one Exploit Die to hide with inconceivable and supernatural skill. So long as there is a place to hide within 60 feet, you instantly appear in one such hidden location of your choice within 60 feet, and are automatically considered to be hidden from all spells and creatures, no matter what senses or magic they might have.

activation.condition: When you take the Hide action

optionalfeature.name: Vorpal Critical
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack, you can spend an Exploit Die to strike with legendary force, dealing bonus damage equal to three Exploit Dice.
If this attack reduces the creature's remaining hit points to 50 or less, you cut off one of its heads. If the creature cannot survive without the lost head, it is killed.
Creatures can use a Legendary Resistance to avoid being beheaded. Creatures that don't have or don't need a head are immune to this Exploit's effects, but still take the damage.

activation.condition: When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Vorpal Strike
entries: {@note You can use this Exploit once per long rest.}
When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one Exploit Die to strike with legendary force, dealing bonus damage equal to four Exploit Dice.
If this attack reduces the creature's remaining hit points to 50 or less, you cut off one of its heads. If the creature cannot survive without the lost head, it is killed.
Creatures can use a Legendary Resistance to avoid being beheaded. Creatures that don't have or don't need a head are immune to this Exploit's effects, but still take the damage.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Arcane Warrior
entries: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the {@loader Wizard|class/LaserLlama; Alternate Wizard.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Intelligence for their spellcasting ability. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these two Wizard Cantrips with another Wizard Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Archery
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons, and your attacks with ranged weapons ignore half-cover and treat three-quarters cover as half cover.

optionalfeature.name: Balanced Fighting
entries: When wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to weapon damage rolls. You can use a {@item shield|PHB} and still gain this benefit.

optionalfeature.name: Bardic Warrior
entries: You learn two cantrips of your Choice from the {@loader Bard|class/LaserLlama; Alternate Bard.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Charisma for their spellcasting ability. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these two Bard Cantrips with another Bard Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Blessed Warrior
entries: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the Cleric spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Wisdom for their spellcasting ability. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these two Cleric Cantrips with another Cleric Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Blind Warrior
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight} with a range in feet equal to 5 times your Proficiency Bonus. In that range, you can see {@condition invisible} targets and anything that isn't behind total cover or hidden from you.

optionalfeature.name: Brawling
entries: On hit, your unarmed strikes deal damage equal to {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier. When you have both hands free, you can make a single unarmed strike, {@action Shove}, or {@action Grapple} as a bonus action on each of your turns.

optionalfeature.name: Classical Swordplay
entries: While wielding a single finesse weapon, no {@item shield|PHB}, and not wearing heavy armor, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls with that weapon and a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

optionalfeature.name: Defensive Fighting
entries: When you are wearing medium armor, heavy armor, or a {@item shield|PHB} you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

optionalfeature.name: Druidic Warrior
entries: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the {@loader Druid|class/LaserLlama; Alternate Druid.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Wisdom for their spellcasting ability. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these two Druid Cantrips with another Druid Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Dual Wielding
entries: While two-weapon fighting, you make your off-hand attack as part of your {@action Attack} action instead of your bonus action, and you add your ability modifier to the damage of this attack. You cannot also make an attack with your bonus action that turn.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Warrior
entries: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the {@loader Warlock|class/LaserLlama; Alternate Warlock.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Charisma for their spellcasting ability. When you gain a level, you can replace one of these Warlock Cantrips with another Warlock Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Exotic Warrior
entries: You are trained in exotic weapons typically associated with performative warriors, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with two {@filter exotic weapons|items|type=exotic weapon|miscellaneous=mundane}.
For you, {@item trident|PHB|tridents} deal {@damage 1d8} ({@damage 1d10}) piercing damage on hit.
When making an attack roll with a {@item net|PHB} against a creature within 5 feet, you do not have disadvantage on the roll.
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, making an attack with a net only takes the place of one attack.

optionalfeature.name: Featherweight Fighting
entries: While you are unarmed or wielding only light weapons, and are not wearing medium or heavy armor, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you gain a +1 bonus to your damage rolls with light melee weapons and unarmed strikes.

optionalfeature.name: Great Weapon Fighting
entries: Whenever you hit a target with a heavy melee weapon attack, you can treat any of the weapon's damage dice as the average roll if you rolled lower: {@dice d4} (2), {@dice d6} (3), {@dice d8} (4), {@dice d10} (5), {@dice d12} (6).

optionalfeature.name: Heavyweight Fighting
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to your damage rolls with heavy melee weapons. When you hit a target with a heavy melee weapon attack, you can use your bonus action on that turn to make a {@action Shove} attack against the same target with advantage.

optionalfeature.name: Hurler
entries: You can draw one thrown weapon as part of a ranged attack you make with it, and the range of your thrown weapon attacks is doubled.
If you are wielding only thrown weapons, you can make a single ranged attack with a thrown weapon as a bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Improvised Fighting
entries: You gain proficiency with improvised weapons. Once per turn, when you hit with an improvised weapon attack that uses a non-magical object, you can choose to destroy the object, rendering is useless for attacks, but deal the maximum possible damage, in place of rolling.

optionalfeature.name: Mariner
entries: When you are not wearing heavy armor or a {@item shield|PHB}, you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.
You also suffer no drawbacks from underwater combat.

optionalfeature.name: Melee Marksman
entries: Having a hostile creature within 5 feet of you does not impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attacks, so long as you are attacking a target within 5 feet.

When you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature within 5 feet, it cannot target you with {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks} for the rest of the turn regardless if you hit or missed your attack.

optionalfeature.name: Mountaineer
entries: So long as you are not wearing heavy armor or a {@item shield|PHB}, you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.
Also, whenever you take falling damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by twice your level.

activation.condition: Whenever you take falling damage

optionalfeature.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: While you are riding a controlled mount, both you and your mount gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class, and you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to command the mount to take one action from its stat block or another action.

optionalfeature.name: Polearm Fighting
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls with {@item glaive|PHB|glaives}, {@item halberd|PHB|halberds}, {@item pike|PHB|pikes}, {@item quarterstaff|PHB|quarterstaffs}, and {@item spear|PHB|spears} so long as you are wielding only that weapon and no {@item shield|PHB}. When doing so, creatures provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks} from you when they enter or move within your reach with that weapon.

optionalfeature.name: Protection
entries: When a creature you can see hits you, or a target within 5 feet with a melee attack, you can use a reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to the target's Armor Class against that attack. You must be wielding a {@item shield|PHB} or a melee weapon.

activation.condition: When a creature you can see hits you or a target within 5 feet with a melee attack

optionalfeature.name: Psionic Warrior
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the {@loader Psion|class/LaserLlama; Psion.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Intelligence for their spellcasting ability. Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these two Psion Cantrips with another Psion Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Shamanistic Warrior
entries: You learn two Cantrips of your choice from the {@loader Shaman|class/LaserLlama; Shaman.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Wisdom for their spellcasting ability. When you gain a level, you can replace one of these Shaman Cantrips with another Shaman Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Shield Warrior
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item shield|PHB|shields} as martial melee weapons. For you, shields deal {@damage 2d4} bludgeoning damage on hit. While you are wielding a shield and no other weapons, you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class and to shield attack rolls.

optionalfeature.name: Sorcerous Warrior
entries: You learn two cantrips of your choice from the {@loader Sorcerer|class/LaserLlama; Alternate Sorcerer.json} spell list. These do not count against your total number of Cantrips Known, and they use Charisma for their spellcasting ability. When you gain a level, you can replace one of these Sorcerer Cantrips with another Sorcerer Cantrip of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Standard Bearer
entries: While holding a standard or banner aloft, and nothing else in that hand, you can rally allied creatures within a radius in feet equal to 5 times your Proficiency Bonus.
When a creature within this radius makes a saving throw, you can use your reaction to grant it advantage on its roll.

activation.condition: When a creature within this radius makes a saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Strongbow
entries: You can use your Strength modifier, in place of Dexterity, for attack and damage rolls with {@item longbow|PHB|longbows} and {@item shortbow|PHB|shortbows}. When you do so, you gain a +1 to damage rolls with those weapons.

optionalfeature.name: Tactical Fighting
entries: You can take the {@action Help} or the {@action Search} action as a bonus action. When you use the Help action to aid an attack, the target can be up to 30 feet away, so long as the attacker can hear you.

optionalfeature.name: Versatile Fighting
entries: While wielding a single versatile weapon and no {@item shield|PHB}, you gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls with that weapon. While doing so, you can use your bonus action to make a {@action grapple} or {@action shove} attack, or to take the {@action Use an Object} action.

optionalfeature.name: Archery Expert
entries: You gain an additional +1 bonus to attack rolls with ranged weapons. Attacking at a weapon's long range no longer imposes disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.

optionalfeature.name: Balanced Expert
entries: When are wielding a versatile melee weapon and a {@item shield|PHB}, you use the versatile weapon's larger damage die, and you can use your shield to do a {@action Shove} attack as a bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Brawling Expert
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to the damage rolls of unarmed strikes. You also gain the benefits below while grappling creatures:

items: You can drag {@condition grappled} creatures up to your full speed.
In place of an attack, you can make another {@action grapple} check against a target you are grappling. On a success, the target is {@condition Restrained} for the duration of that grapple.

optionalfeature.name: Classical Swordplay Expert
entries: When are hit by an attack while using {@optfeature Classical Swordplay|LLFS}, you can use your reaction to add your Dexterity modifier to your Armor Class against that attack.

activation.condition: When are hit by an attack while using Classical Swordplay

optionalfeature.name: Defensive Expert
entries: While wearing heavy armor you can reduce all non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage you take by your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).
If your armor is magical, this can also reduce magical damage of the types above.

optionalfeature.name: Dual Wielding Expert
entries: One-handed melee weapons are considered to have the Light property for you, and when you are wielding a melee weapon in each hand, you gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

optionalfeature.name: Featherweight Expert
entries: When {@optfeature Featherweight Fighting|LLFS}, creatures have disadvantage on {@action Opportunity Attack||opportunity attacks} against you, and you can take the {@action Disengage} action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

optionalfeature.name: Great Weapon Expert
entries: Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a heavy melee weapon attack, you can make another attack as part of that action, bonus action, or reaction with the same weapon.

activation.condition: Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a heavy melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Heavyweight Expert
entries: When you hit a creature equal to your size or smaller with a heavy melee weapon attack you can knock it 5 feet away from you in a straight line so long as the space behind the creature is unoccupied.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature equal to your size or smaller with a heavy melee weapon attack

optionalfeature.name: Mounted Expert
entries: While you are riding a trained mount, you have advantage on melee attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, and whenever your mount takes damage you can use your reaction to take that damage in its stead.

optionalfeature.name: Polearm Expert
entries: Whenever you take the {@action Attack} action while using {@optfeature Polearm Fighting|LLFS}, you can use your bonus action on that turn to make a melee attack with the end of your weapon. On hit, it deals bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d4}+ your Strength modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Protection Expert
entries: When a creature within 5 feet is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to interpose a {@item shield|PHB}, adding your Proficiency Bonus to its saving throw roll.
You can use this reaction after the creature rolls the d20, but before you know the outcome of its saving throw.

activation.condition: When a creature within 5 feet is forced to make a Dexterity saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Shield Expert
entries: While wielding a {@item shield|PHB}, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to make a {@action Shove} attack, even if you do not take the {@action Attack} action. You also add the Armor Class bonus from your shield to any Dexterity saving throws you make.

optionalfeature.name: Superior Technique
entries: You learn one {@filter 1st-degree Martial Exploit|optionalfeatures|feature type=LL:1ME} from those available to the Alternate Fighter, but it doesn't count against your total Exploits Known. You also gain one additional Exploit Die.
